gloss: distracting thoughts; idle thoughts; stray thoughts

definitions.gloss: distracting thoughts; idle thoughts; stray thoughts
definitions.explanation: Unwanted or irrelevant thoughts that interfere with concentration, meditation, or focused work. Originally a Buddhist term referring to thoughts that obstruct spiritual practice, now used broadly for any mental distractions.

examples.japanese: {雑念|ざつねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}って→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}する→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧。
examples.english: Clear away distracting thoughts and concentrate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{瞑想|めいそう}→瞑想：13660_meisou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最中|さいちゅう}→最中：02821_saichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雑念|ざつねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かんで→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧くる。
examples.english: Distracting thoughts come to mind during meditation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雑念|ざつねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てて→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧、⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{専念|せんねん}→専念：09211_sennen⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: Before exams, you need to cast aside distracting thoughts and devote yourself to studying.

notes:
USAGE:
{雑念|ざつねん} originally comes from Buddhist practice, where it refers to thoughts that obstruct meditation. In modern usage, it broadly means any unwanted mental distractions during focused activities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雑念|ざつねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to clear away distracting thoughts)
- {雑念|ざつねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧ (to cast aside distracting thoughts)
- {雑念|ざつねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧ (distracting thoughts arise)
- {雑念|ざつねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧とらわれる (to be caught up in distracting thoughts)
- {雑念|ざつねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{払|はら}う→振り払う：06239_furiharau⟧ (to shake off distracting thoughts)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {雑念|ざつねん}: distracting thoughts (interfere with focus)
- {邪念|じゃねん}: wicked thoughts, impure thoughts (morally negative)
- ⟦{妄想|もうそう}→妄想：06813_mousou⟧: delusion, fantasy (unrealistic imaginings)
